svg.text: Original → Constraints → Compression → Semantic Check → Risk

g.text: 02 Compression Level: L0 / L1 / L2 / L3
03 Hard Constraints: subject / action / time / camera / causality
05 Semantic Check: preserved / weakened / lost / invented
06 Reverse Expansion: recover the original semantic commitments
07 Risk: identify unsafe compression or continuity loss

svg.text: Rule: compress wording, not the semantics required by the video.
A shorter prompt is not automatically a better prompt.
